capabilities.label: Applications and distribution
capabilities.description: Functional grouping; children are independently selectable, subject to real dependencies.

capabilities.label: Native text inference and grounded extraction
capabilities.description: Needle2 and Needle3 lifecycle, completion, embeddings, tool execution, strict grounding, confidence and automatic date facts.

capabilities.label: Typed tool and extraction schemas
capabilities.description: Callable decorators, Field constraints, Pydantic v1/v2 schemas and annotation/docstring-derived tool contracts.

capabilities.label: Isolated tuned-model workers
capabilities.description: Private subprocess protocol, model loading, completion/embedding/reset and reliable process cleanup.

capabilities.label: Native text engines and weight downloads
capabilities.description: Generation 2/3 text runtime engines, base .cact weights, Hub archives, versioned caches and platform/libc selection.

capabilities.label: Speech transcription and streaming
capabilities.description: Whistle model lifecycle, PCM/WAV input, sample-rate conversion, languages, keywords, timestamps, embeddings, streaming and microphone/compare workflows.

capabilities.label: Telemetry controls and diagnostics
capabilities.description: Opt-out-aware anonymous event delivery that never blocks application behavior or discloses request/model content.

capabilities.label: Safe checkpoints and tokenization
capabilities.description: Safetensors model/adapter metadata and nested tensors, SentencePiece markers and lazy tokenizer retrieval.

capabilities.label: JAX attention model and subnetworks
capabilities.description: Needle3 configurations, causal and local attention, engram memory, Monarch Hadamard MLP, lane mixing, depth/width ladders, probe heads and KV sizing.

capabilities.label: MLX numerical backend
capabilities.description: MLX forward, ladder output, quantized parameters and gradients matching declared JAX contracts.

capabilities.label: Deployment quantization numerics
capabilities.description: Uniform and Cactus quantizers, codebooks, normalized transforms, reduction-axis policy, AB calibration, STE and query/KV deployment settings.

capabilities.label: Portable CACT export and deployment builds
capabilities.description: Exact binary archive compatibility, tokenizer attachment, optional heads/audio tensors, depth selection, LoRA merge and platform packaging.

capabilities.label: Reference checkpoint generation
capabilities.description: Needle3-only checkpoint validation, greedy or seeded sampling, prompt rendering, context limits and streaming.

capabilities.label: Text data generation and LoRA tuning
capabilities.description: OpenRouter sample generation, native and chat JSONL normalization, supervised token masks, seeded LoRA training and quantized validation.

capabilities.label: Whistle model and speech LoRA tuning
capabilities.description: Speech features/encoder/decoder, multilingual vocabulary extension, clip filtering, LoRA plus embedding rows, error metrics and compatible export.

capabilities.label: Hosted training and account workflows
capabilities.description: Authenticated API requests, safe redirects/signed downloads, retries, data generation, uploads, jobs, models, cancellation, polling and billing.

capabilities.label: Runtime artifact CLI
capabilities.description: Lightweight help and fetch/download commands for native text engines, base weights and Hub archives. Training, hosted, speech and playground commands are separate optional workflows.

capabilities.label: Interactive local browser playground
capabilities.description: HTTP endpoints, browser assets, editable tools, conversation reset, asynchronous local tuning, logs and model downloads.

capabilities.label: Stateful device and application environments
capabilities.description: Six stateful, executable tool surfaces: smart home, media, productivity, wearable, data capture and kitchen appliances.

capabilities.label: Installable text runtime
capabilities.description: Python >=3.9 distribution, public text API, console entrypoint, lightweight dependencies, setup entrypoints and Apache notices.

capabilities.label: Training checkpoint and speech-weight downloads
capabilities.description: Optional artifact retrieval for training and speech; a shared fetch implementation does not require these workflows in the core edition.

capabilities.label: Training and reference-model CLI
capabilities.description: Optional command workflow, separate from runtime artifact fetching even though the original shares one file.

capabilities.label: Speech CLI
capabilities.description: Optional command workflow, separate from runtime artifact fetching even though the original shares one file.

capabilities.label: Hosted platform CLI
capabilities.description: Optional command workflow, separate from runtime artifact fetching even though the original shares one file.

capabilities.label: Browser playground CLI
capabilities.description: Optional command workflow, separate from runtime artifact fetching even though the original shares one file.

capabilities.label: Training, speech and web distribution extras
capabilities.description: Optional install extras and packaged resources for excluded workflows.

capabilities.label: Upstream release automation
capabilities.description: Maintainer publishing workflows, outside the local inference core.

installation.description: 在新建 Python 环境构建并安装候选 wheel，然后从源码目录外验证导入及命令入口。训练与浏览器行为另由上面的检查验证。

configuration.功能选择: all · 26 个末端能力，31 个树节点（含分组）
configuration.规模目标: 初始 49%；用户后续放宽，功能优先
configuration.实现调用上限: 20 次；其中优化调用最多 6 次
configuration.资源: 分配 16 CPU · 64 GiB · 12 小时；补充检查固定使用 2 核
configuration.原版测试: 原样保留；额外检查位于独立验证目录
configuration.编译缓存: 补充训练与网页检查启用；按原版/候选及提交隔离

limitations: 检查通过只证明这些输入与环境下的观测，不能证明所有输入上的语义等价。
原版失败、候选回归、未运行及不确定结果分别列出。
验证环境为 Python 3.11.16 / Linux ARM64 CPU；包声明的其他 Python 版本未在本轮逐一运行。结果不覆盖 macOS Metal、CUDA GPU、真实麦克风设备或需要凭证的远程服务端；相关接口仍保留在功能范围内。
源码与配置使用 tiktoken 0.12.0 / cl100k_base；仅不变的原版测试、文档和二进制资源排除，新建或修改的文本仍计入规模。
模型用量只统计本轮运行器登记的 Controller / author 调用，不包含当前对话、人工监督及报告制作的模型用量。
本轮没有进行后续开发任务成本对比，因此不报告认知负担或后续任务 tokens 的降低比例。
实际模型名称未必由运行事件独立证明；本页列出调用时指定的模型配置。
运行墙钟从本次成功提交进入队列开始计算，不包含此前静态准备、未提交成功的调度器配置重试以及报告制作。
公开摘要省略命令参数、环境变量、本地路径、模型完整对话和私有验收内容。
